de: Franz Rademacher proposes plans to make Madagascar the "Jewish homeland", an idea that had first been considered by 19th century journalist Theodor Herzl.

te: The Dunkirk evacuation ends: The British Armed Forces completes evacuation of 338,000 troops from Dunkirk in France. To…

de: World War II: After a brief lull in the Battle of France, the Germans renew the offensive against the remaining French divisions south of the River Somme in Operation Fall Rot ("Case Red").

de: King Haakon VII, Crown Prince Olav and the Norwegian government leave Tromsø and go into exile in London. They return exactly five years later.

de: World War II: U.S. President Franklin D. Roosevelt denounces Italy's actions in his "Stab in the Back" speech at the graduation ceremonies of the University of Virginia.

dz: 二战:德军对挪威占领的军事抵抗结束.

te: The German occupation of Paris begins.
dz: 二战:德国占领巴黎开始.
de: World War II: The German occupation of Paris begins.

dz: 苏联向立陶宛提出最后通牒,导致立陶宛丧失独立.

de: World War II: Operation Aerial begins: Allied troops start to evacuate France, following Germany's takeover of Paris and most of the nation.

te: RMS Lancastria is attacked and sunk by the Luftwaffe near Saint-Nazaire, France. At least 3,000 are killed in Britain's…
dz: 二战:兰卡斯特里亚号被法国圣纳泽尔附近的路夫特瓦菲号所攻击并击沉. 在英国最严重的海上灾难中至少有3000人丧生.
de: World War II: RMS Lancastria is attacked and sunk by the Luftwaffe near Saint-Nazaire, France. At least 3,000 are killed in Britain's worst maritime disaster.

dz: 二战:夏尔·戴高乐于6月18日发出的呼吁.
de: World War II: Appeal of 18 June by Charles de Gaulle.

t: "Finest Hour"演讲由温斯顿·丘吉尔发表.
te: The "Finest Hour" speech is delivered by Winston Churchill.
dz: 二战:"Finest Hour"演讲由温斯顿·丘吉尔发表.
de: World War II: The "Finest Hour" speech is delivered by Winston Churchill.

t: 意大利开始对法国进行不成功的入侵.
te: Italy begins an unsuccessful invasion of France.
dz: 二战:意大利开始对法国进行不成功的入侵.
de: World War II: Italy begins an unsuccessful invasion of France.

t: 法国被迫同德国签订第二次通合停战协议,乘坐德国人在1918年签署停战协议的同一辆铁路车.

dz: 二战:法国被迫同德国签订第二次通合停战协议,乘坐德国人在1918年签署停战协议的同一辆铁路车.

dz: 亨利·拉森(Henry Larsen)从加拿大不列颠哥伦比亚省温哥华开始从西北道向西向东成功进行首次通航.
de: Henry Larsen begins the first successful west-to-east navigation of Northwest Passage from Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada.

de: World War II: Under the Molotov–Ribbentrop Pact, the Soviet Union presents an ultimatum to Romania requiring it to cede Bessarabia and the northern part of Bukovina.

t: 罗马尼亚在面临最后通牒后将比萨拉比亚和北布科维纳割让给苏联。

de: Romania cedes Bessarabia and Northern Bukovina to the Soviet Union after facing an ultimatum.

te: The Royal Navy attacks the French naval squadron in Algeria, to ensure that it will not fall under German control. Of t…
dz: 二战:英国皇家海军出击法国在阿尔及利亚的海军中队,以确保它不会被德军所控制. 在现存的四艘法国战列舰中,有一艘被击沉,两艘被损坏,有一艘逃回了法国.
de: World War II: The Royal Navy attacks the French naval squadron in Algeria, to ensure that it will not fall under German control. Of the four French battleships present, one is sunk, two are damaged, and one escapes back to France.

te: Foreign relations of Vichy France are severed with the United Kingdom.
dz: 第二次世界大战：维希法国与英国断绝外交关系。
de: World War II: Foreign relations of Vichy France are severed with the United Kingdom.

dz: 故事桥(英语:Sorry Bridge)是布里斯班的重要地标,也是澳大利亚最长的罐头桥被正式开放.
de: Story Bridge, a major landmark in Brisbane, as well as Australia's longest cantilever bridge is formally opened.

de: World War II: Six days before Adolf Hitler issues his Directive 16 to the combined Wehrmacht armed forces for Operation Sea Lion, the Kanalkampf shipping attacks begin against British maritime convoys in the leadup to initiating the Battle of Britain.

t: 二战:维希政府在法国成立.
te: The Vichy government is established in France.
dz: 二战:维希政府在法国成立.
de: World War II: The Vichy government is established in France.

dz: 元帅仪式:二战中第一次由阿道夫·希特勒因军事成就任命元帅.
de: Field Marshal Ceremony: First occasion in World War II that Adolf Hitler appoints field marshals due to military achievements.

de: World War II: Battle of Cape Spada: The Royal Navy and the Regia Marina clash; the Italian light cruiser Bartolomeo Colleoni sinks, with 121 casualties.

t: 丹麦离开国际联盟.
te: Denmark leaves the League of Nations.
dz: 丹麦离开国际联盟.
de: Denmark leaves the League of Nations.

t: 加利福尼亚州开通了第一条高速公路，Arroyo Seco Parkway。
te: California opens its first freeway, the Arroyo Seco Parkway.
dz: 加利福尼亚州开通了第一条高速公路，Arroyo Seco Parkway。
de: California opens its first freeway, the Arroyo Seco Parkway.

de: The United States' Under Secretary of State Sumner Welles issues a declaration on the U.S. non-recognition policy of the Soviet annexation and incorporation of three Baltic states: Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania.

t: 亨利·吉桑将军命令瑞士军队抵抗德军入侵,并宣布投降为非法.

dz: 亨利·吉桑将军命令瑞士军队抵抗德军入侵,并宣布投降为非法.

dz: 动画短片"野兔"发布,引入了"Bugs Bunny"的角色.
de: The animated short A Wild Hare is released, introducing the character of Bugs Bunny.

dz: 二战:苏联正式兼并拉脱维亚.
de: World War II: The Soviet Union formally annexes Latvia.

dz: 爱沙尼亚被苏联吞并。

dz: 意大利一艘潜艇在和平时期将希腊巡洋舰埃利号在蒂诺斯港下沉,这标志着意大利在10月格里克-意大利战争爆发前最严重的挑衅.
de: An Italian submarine torpedoes and sinks the Greek cruiser Elli at Tinos harbor during peacetime, marking the most serious Italian provocation prior to the outbreak of the Greco-Italian War in October.

de: World War II: The Hardest Day air battle, part of the Battle of Britain, takes place. At that point, it is the largest aerial engagement in history with heavy losses sustained on both sides.

dz: B-25米切尔中型轰炸机首飞.
